title: Google Ads AI: write better ads and stop paying for junk searches
seoTitle: Google Ads AI: write ads and cut wasted spend
description: Use Google Ads AI help from your own assistant: write responsive search ads within the limits, find wasted spend and build negative keyword lists.
lede: The most useful Google Ads AI help is your own assistant doing three jobs. It writes responsive search ads within Google's limits, identifies searches that cost money without producing sales, and turns them into negative keywords. This guide gives you the steps, two prompts and a worked example.
